# Block reference

<!-- Generated by tools/block-reference.php from blocks/*/block.json and render.php. Do not edit by hand: run php tools/block-reference.php. -->

Every Golden Hive block, its attributes and their defaults. A Golden Hive
block is drawn by the server, so in a page it is a single self-closing
comment: `<!-- wp:golden-hive/name {"attribute":"value"} /-->`. An attribute
left out takes its default. How to put pages together is in
[pages.md](pages.md); `php tools/check-page.php page.html` checks a page
against this reference.

Every block also accepts WordPress's own `className`, `anchor`, `align`
and `style`.

A default reading **Negozio → …** is the store's own detail (Customizer →
Golden Hive → Negozio): leave the attribute out to show it, write it to show
something else on that page, write it empty (`""`) to hide it there.
